name: Proposal Calculator Behavior Tracking Module
description: Calculator displays behavior_tracking_module as a priced add-on (30% of base investment, not selected by default): first-party session/view tracking, interest map, journey funnel, built-in behavior panel (up to 8 KPIs / 4 charts), device breakdown and 12-month retention. Selecting it adds base*30% to the effective total; the technical document epic linked via module-behavior_tracking_module is gated by the selection.
